title: Credit accounting + guardrail
description: The #1 Discord complaint by far (Lee/Steve/Dave C/Topher/Joel/Ian): credit spend is invisible and pipelines exhaust mid-job leaving partial state. agent-edit already captures ai_credits_used. Add: capture media_seconds_used on import (+ publish); maintain a running session credit total and emit it; parse 402 into 'X required / Y available' (Ian confirmed the number exists server-side); optional DESCRIPT_CREDIT_CAP env that aborts before submit when projected/known cost exceeds it (Dave caps at 100cr/job). No credits-remaining endpoint exists, so track cumulatively.
acceptance_criteria: Every job surfaces credits + media-seconds used; session total available; 402 yields a clear 'out of credits (need X, have Y)' error; optional hard cap aborts before spend.

title: Webhook / callback_url support
description: Tools poll only; DescriptClient payload types already allow callback_url but tools don't expose it and there is no receiver. For long jobs (scottekim's 90-min media = 14-min job) webhooks beat polling and survive disconnects (he lost the MCP connector 5x in 3h). Expose callback_url on import/agentEdit/publish tools + add an optional webhook receiver route. Descript POSTs the full GET /jobs/{id} payload on completion.
acceptance_criteria: callback_url settable from tools; receiver verified to fire with full job payload (Phase 2); polling remains the default fallback.

title: Multi-file import in importMedia tool
description: src/mastra/tools/import-media.ts hardcodes single add_media{clip1}. The underlying DescriptClient.importMedia ALREADY supports multi-key add_media + multi-clip compositions + folder_name + callback_url — only the tool wrapper is single-file. Accept an array of media (key/url/language) and build the keyed add_media + composition internally (Adam Malik's 5/8 array-ergonomics point). Enables landonward's 4-6 clip shoots + Pokercode-Hannes's facecam+screenshare sequences.
acceptance_criteria: importMedia accepts N media in one call; composition references all clips; verified via a real multi-file import (Phase 2).

description: DO NOT RUN WITHOUT EXPLICIT GO-AHEAD — every agentEdit burns real AI credits. Smallest possible prompts, measure everything. (2) Confirm agent_response + project_changed populate on real runs. (3) Hunt for a skip-brief / direct-execute flag; reproduce Lee/Dave C's headless plan-approval stall (project_changed:false, nothing built). (4) Long-job duration vs the 30-min poll cap (scottekim's 90-min job = 14 min real). (5) Multitrack publish — does it fail without a manual flatten (Pokercode-Hannes)? (6) Any transcript/subtitle endpoint? Test published_projects subtitles (WEBVTT).

description: Model choice is the biggest cost lever (hector: haiku 4.5 <5cr/clip; Topher: 'auto' 40-60cr/clip). agentEdit exposes model but defaults to Underlord default (likely expensive). title: URL pre-validation before import
description: Fail fast (save media minutes) before submitting a bad import URL. Descript requires public/pre-signed URL with HTTP Range support + valid Content-Type (aakrokr's analysis: validator does HEAD + GET Range:0-0). Pre-flight a HEAD + Range:0-0 check in importMedia and reject with a clear message instead of burning a job. Informed by the Phase 1 metadata-repro.
acceptance_criteria: Bad/non-range/non-public URLs rejected pre-submit with a specific reason; valid URLs pass through unchanged.

acceptance_criteria: project_changed:false reported as a distinct non-success outcome with actionable message; skip-brief flag wired if it exists.
